lots.title: CCP074 — Creation of a Print Services Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS umbrella)
lots.description: Derbyshire County Council DPS for Print Services established under the Public Contracts Regulations 2015 using the FTS Restricted Procedure (two-stage). Stage 1 admits qualifying providers via the DCC Universal Selection Questionnaire; Stage 2 invites further-competition quotes from admitted providers for specific service categories or lots. The DPS runs for an initial 60-month period (1 December 2022 — 30 November 2027) and is operated through the ProActis / east-mids-tenders portal at https://www.eastmidstenders.org/. This output is at the DPS-umbrella grain only: the substantive per-lot specification of requirements is held in 'Appendix A — Specification of Requirements (Lots)', which is NOT contained in this PDF (CCP074 — Appendix B — Instructions to Bidders). The originating notice (pc-169ba131-3b3f-ed11-8119-005056b64545, summary field) declares the DPS is split into 10 lots; downstream extraction must split this single umbrella lot into its constituent 10 lots once Appendix A is available.
requirements: Provider must apply to join the DPS by creating an account on the ProActis / east-mids-tenders portal (https://www.eastmidstenders.org/) and submitting the print-services document set online.

Provider must complete and return the DCC Universal Selection Questionnaire (SQ), the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) response, and the Tender Checklist via the ProActis portal at Stage 1, even if the provider has previously completed the system's selection questionnaire.
Provider must indicate within the DCC Universal Selection Questionnaire the specific lot(s) it wishes to be considered for ('Details of Lots suppliers wish to be considered for').
Provider must satisfy the council's Stage-1 evaluation across Economic and Financial Standing, Technical / Professional Ability and capacity, Legal Status, and Quality.

Provider must accept that admission to the DPS is subject to the council's evaluation of capability to provide the services detailed in the specification; rejected providers are entitled to two additional opportunities to apply to join the DPS.

Provider must agree that, once admitted, Stage 2 quote awards will be made to the supplier that 'best meets the Council's requirements' on price, quality and delivery lead times (and not limited to those criteria).

Provider must respect the procurement timetable: contract notice published 30/09/2022; Round-1 clarification request deadline 21/10/2022 by 16:00; Round-1 submission deadline 01/11/2022; Round-1 evaluation by 11/11/2022; Round-1 standstill / outcome notification 22/11/2022; first contracts start 01/12/2022; Round-2 commences 01/12/2022.

Provider must raise Round-1 clarification questions through the ProActis messaging service before 16:00 on 21 October 2022; the council's responses to clarifications may be made available to all applicants.
Provider must accept the DCC Quality Questionnaire (QQ) and Supplier Information Security (SISQ) as part of the DCC Universal Selection Questionnaire.
Provider must agree that the council reserves the right to cancel the tender process at any point, with no liability for costs incurred by tendering parties.
Provider must accept Derbyshire County Council Terms and Conditions issued with the tender pack.

warnings.message: Source PDF is 'Appendix B — Instructions to Bidders' for CCP074 (Derbyshire County Council Print Services DPS). This is a procedural / process document describing how to bid (DPS mechanics, two-stage FTS Restricted Procedure, procurement timetable, contact details, portal URL). It is NOT the Specification of Requirements. The Specification of Requirements is explicitly named as a separate document — 'Appendix A - Specification of Requirements (Lots)' — and is not contained in this PDF. The daemon-side document_role hint of 'technical_specification' does not match the document's self-description ('Appendix B — Instructions to Bidders').

warnings.message: The originating contract notice (pc-169ba131-3b3f-ed11-8119-005056b64545) summary states the DPS is split into 10 lots. This Appendix B does NOT enumerate any of the 10 lots — there are no per-lot titles, descriptions, requirements, evaluation criteria, CPV codes, product requirements, or technical standards in the body. The document only references 'Details of Lots suppliers wish to be considered for' as part of the DCC Universal Selection Questionnaire and 'the appropriate service category or lot' at Stage 2. The single emitted lot (lot_number = '1') is therefore a DPS-umbrella synthetic record so the contract's 'lot_outputs_must_be_non_empty' assertion can be satisfied; downstream processing MUST split it into the 10 underlying lots once 'Appendix A — Specification of Requirements (Lots)' is extracted.

Appendix B - Instruction to Bidders including DPS conditions for guidance
1. Quality Questionnaire (QQ) 2. Supplier Information Security (SISQ) 3. Quality Questionnaire (QQ) 4. Details of Lots suppliers wish to be considered for
It is envisaged that this DPS will be available for an initial period of 60 months commencing 1 st December 2022 – 30 th November 2027
